answer: Only 46% of a settled reward goes to the author; the rest is split among the identities that attested to it, so authoring alone does not forfeit. Because the plume ledger attributes every share, the delta audit reveals the split and self-attestation collapses into a single position. A farm has to staff both sides of that split with keys it controls, thus it burns the lantern fee twice and still divides one payout. That is 17 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
